You are eligible for a merit concession of **₹36,250** on next year's tuition (25% of your annual tuition) [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2 Merit concession slabs].

### Working and Eligibility Details:
* **CGPA:** 9.01 ≥ 9.00 (qualifies for the 25% slab) [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2 Merit concession slabs; Profile used].
* **Fee ledger:** has_overdue_dues is False (meets the eligibility condition of having no overdue entries) [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §3 Eligibility conditions; Profile used].
* **Calculation:** 25% × ₹1,45,000 [SQL] = **₹36,250** [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §4 Calculation and application].

This concession will be credited against next year's tuition and split proportionally across the two instalments [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §4 Calculation and application].
sql: SELECT fs.component, fs.amount FROM fee_structure AS fs JOIN departments AS d ON fs.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.code = 'CS' AND fs.year_of_study = 3 AND fs.component = 'tuition' AND fs.academic_year = '2026-27' LIMIT 200
